reason: GeneralResponseV4 made safety precedence deterministic, but the expanded live corpus produced A_WIN 20-0 for semantically equivalent code solely from reasoning_quality. GeneralResponseV5 raises the inclusive tie margin from 10 to 20 so one low-weight criterion cannot decide tournament progression.

recovery.action: No recovery is required. The revision is non-payable and must receive no new submissions.

sanitization: Only allowlisted deployment and canonical summary fields are retained. Raw receipts, traces, validator configuration, stdout, and stderr are not stored.
